If I mount an NFS v4.1 server to a single client multiple times and then
run xfstests over each mountpoint I usually get the client into a state
where recovery deadlocks.  The server informs the client of a
bind_connection_to_session and checks the status of the lease.
I found that bind_connection_to_session sets the NFS4_SESSION_DRAINING

column2: but this flag is never unset before

column1: nfs4_check_lease() reaches nfs4_proc_sequence().  This causes the client

column2: halting all NFS activity to the server.  nfs4_proc_sequence()

column1: is only called by the state manager
column2: so I can change it to run in privileged

column1: mode to bypass the NFS4_SESSION_DRAINING check and avoid the deadlock.
